name: Bayesian Curl
instructions: Set a cable pulley to the lowest position and stand facing away, holding the handle behind you.
Step forward so the cable pulls your arm slightly behind your torso — this lengthens the biceps.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder, keeping the upper arm still.
Lower slowly to full extension. The behind-body angle keeps tension on the long head.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: An intermediate cable pull-pattern exercise for the biceps. Bayesian Curl strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
